Visual theme for the TB Progress Tracker app

Source: R/app.R
tb_app_theme.Rd

A bslib::bs_theme() with the colours and fonts used by the app. Exported so that the app (which lives in inst/app) and any custom app can share it.

Usage

tb_app_theme()

Value

A bslib::bs_theme() object.

Examples

tb_app_theme()
